title: bt-dht: make parser more robust to broken packets
description:
Fixes several bugs that would cause the bt-dht parser to read past the end of the buffer (using tvb_ functions) when given broken packets. These were mostly caused by assuming length fields were correct, or assuming end markers would always be present.

The string parsing is refactored a bit to separate the string length from the error signal to make sure zero length strings aren't interpreted as parse errors.

Some parser functions were also made stricter by checking that the data type character is present. This will often (but not always) have been checked by the caller, but making each function check its expectations will prevent future problems when they are used from different contexts. This also applies to some of the added checks for empty buffers.

The tests I ended up writing while working on this are in a [separate branch](https://gitlab.com/zidel_/wireshark/-/blob/dht_tests/epan/dissectors/test/test_dissectors.c) since they aren't ready for a merge request.

This has created a number of infinite loops and stack overflows. Reading past the end of the buffer with `tvb_` functions has the advantage of triggering exceptions.
If you return `offset + 1`, you now return 1 on errors, because this doesn't check if `dissect_bencoded_int` or `dissect_bencoded_string` returned 0.
That results in the offset going backwards, because other code treats a return offset as 0 as an error, but won't treat a return of 0 as an error.

commits_data.title: bt-dht: fix offset off-by-one after parsing error
commits_data.message:
bt-dht: fix offset off-by-one after parsing error

By returning offset here the next byte the caller would read is the list
end marker that belongs to the error. Since the parent structure is a
dict we would end the parsing of that dict too soon.

commits_data.title: bt-dht: fix parsing of broken dicts
commits_data.message:
bt-dht: fix parsing of broken dicts

Improve the parsing of a few cases of broken dicts:
* Empty buffers
* Incorrect opening marker
* Missing end marker

commits_data.title: bt-dht: stricter parsing of lists
commits_data.message:
bt-dht: stricter parsing of lists

Avoid trying to read past the end of the buffer when asked to parse a
list from a buffer that is either empty or is missing the end marker.
Also double check that we are actually getting the l we expect the list
to start with.

commits_data.title: bt-dht: make integer parsing stricter and more robust
commits_data.message:
bt-dht: make integer parsing stricter and more robust

* Handle empty buffer (possible though dissect_bt_dht_error)
* Check that the i is present since not all callers check for us
* Don't read past end of buffer when end marker is missing

commits_data.title: bt-dht: fix parsing of strings with invalid length
commits_data.message:
bt-dht: fix parsing of strings with invalid length

Fail properly instead of trying to read past the buffer when the string
we are parsing it too long.

Fixes the BT-DHT portion of #17934

commits_data.title: dt-dht: avoid using string length 0 as error marker
commits_data.message:
dt-dht: avoid using string length 0 as error marker

Change the string length parsing to split the parsed length from the
success/failure state. This lets us handle zero length strings without
confusing them with parse errors.

commits_data.title: bt-dht: improve string length parsing
commits_data.message:
bt-dht: improve string length parsing

Avoid trying to read past the end of the packet when reading string
lengths from buffers that are either empty or don't contain the end
marker.
